name: Khalil Bou Dargham
quote: I would like to recommend Parwez, with whom I have had the pleasure of working closely at SPAN for the past five years. Mohammad is an exceptionally hardworking and smart individual, and it has been a joy to collaborate with him. Mohammad's dedication and commitment to his work are truly commendable. His work ethic is characterized by a strong sense of responsibility and an unwavering commitment to excellence. Regardless of the challenges, Mohammad consistently demonstrates resilience and determination, making him an invaluable asset to any team or project.
